conditions.note: Copied from the RDAT ANNOTATION line; cross-checked against the file at run time.

mask_reason: No extra masking: positions without data are already NaN in the RDAT.

report_notes.construct: Csde1 mRNA fragment, nucleotides 190-386 (RMDB name 'Csde1_190_386'), DMS mutate-and-map; only the WT row is used (CSDE1_DMS_0001 is a second entry of the same design with fewer data points).
report_notes.region: R = 1-50: the 5' end of the fragment. The region of interest is the 5'-most stretch with data (uniform rule across datasets: first 50 nt, 100 nt for the 1266-nt HOXA9 UTR), with 5'-anchored windows mimicking the mRNA use case.
data_caveats: The RDAT annotations give no temperature, buffer or Mg2+; RNAfold uses 37 °C (default) and this is flagged.
This is an internal fragment of the mRNA, so the 'full fold' is itself a truncation of the natural transcript.
